name: Budget
description: A budget that assigns an amount on a monthly, quarterly, or annual basis to a specific account or customer, giving a business measurable expense goals for a given time period.

update.note: Full update; the request body must include all writable fields plus Id and SyncToken. Writable fields omitted from the request body are set to NULL.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default. Required for update.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. It is used to lock an object for use by one app at a time. As soon as an application modifies an object, its SyncToken is incremented. Required for update.

fields.name: BudgetEntryType
fields.description: Period that this budget detail covers.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: User recognizable name for the Account. Account.Name attribute must not contain double quotes (") or colon (:).

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Budgeted amount for this detail line.

attributes.name: BudgetDate
attributes.description: Date that this budget detail amount applies to.

attributes.name: AccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the account for this budget detail.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced account.

attributes.name: CustomerRef
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for this budget detail.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced customer.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The display name of the referenced customer.

fields.name: BudgetType
fields.description: Budget types. The only value currently supported is ProfitAndLoss.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: Whether or not active; inactive accounts may be hidden from most display purposes and may not be posted to.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object. The MetaData values are set by Data Services and are read only for all applications.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated.
